articles.title: Missing ITR deadline today is like getting ‘Hit Wicket’: Tax department urges a ‘Free Hit’ filing
articles.summary: The Income Tax Department, in a recent X post, reminded taxpayers that 31 July is the last date to file ITR-1 and ITR-2 for AY 2026-27. Complete filing and e-verification today to avoid late fees, interest and compliance issues.

articles.title: ITR filing 2026: How to report capital gains from shares, mutual funds and ETFs to avoid tax notices
articles.summary: Taxpayers must accurately report capital gains from shares, mutual funds, and ETFs while filing the ITR for AY 2026-27. It is important to choose the correct ITR form, classify gains, reconcile investment records, and report only realised gains to avoid discrepancies and scrutiny.

articles.title: Does India’s DIY mutual fund boom needs structured assistance?
articles.summary: Over 5-6 crore Indians now invest in mutual funds, thanks to digital platforms. While ease of access has increased, first-time investors face complexities in asset allocation. Future investing will require curated advice and structured assistance to ensure successful long-term portfolios.

articles.title: A financial master sheet won't make you richer—but it could save your family from economic chaos
articles.summary: A financial master sheet is a single document that records the family's financial and administrative details, showing what assets exist, where they are held, and where supporting documents are stored.

articles.title: Why large-cap funds are losing their alpha edge post-2010: Key factors behind decline and what investors should do
articles.summary: Large-cap funds have seen their alpha generation decline over the years compared with the Nifty 50 TRI. While funds outperformed strongly during 2000-2009, the advantage narrowed in the following decade and turned negative after 2020.

articles.title: Not reporting bank interest or LTCG in your ITR? Avoid these 2 common tax filing mistakes
articles.summary: Many taxpayers mistakenly assume that TDS-deducted income or tax-exempt LTCG need not be disclosed in their ITR. Such omissions can create mismatches with AIS and Form 26AS, leading to tax notices or adjustments even when no additional tax is payable.

articles.title: Pay commission: Maharashtra approves incentive allowance at 30% of basic pay for Anti-Narcotics Task Force personnel
articles.summary: The Maharashtra government has approved incentive allowance equivalent to 30% of basic pay for police officers and personnel in the Anti-Narcotics Task Force (ANTF) under the 7th central pay commission.

articles.title: ITR deadline 2026: Govt says portal can handle 1 cr returns daily; experts explain why you shouldn't wait until July 31
articles.summary: The government says the income tax e-filing portal can process up to 1 crore ITRs a day, but experts say taxpayers should not mistake higher capacity for a risk-free last-day filing experience. Here's why they don't expect an extension yet, and why waiting until July 31 could still be costly.

articles.title: Active large-cap funds closely mirror Nifty 50 index: New study finds 90% overlap in sectoral allocation
articles.summary: Active large-cap funds may not provide as much diversification as many investors expect. A study shows their sector allocations and stock portfolios closely mirror the Nifty 50, with the overlap becoming even higher among the largest funds.
